claims: Approves a WebFetch of an http or https URL in plan mode, so gathering context for a plan does not prompt.
Approves shell commands proved read-only, and plan-mode investigation and plan_allow_tools tools under an open posture.
Records the user's `approve <code>` replies, so a command refused in auto mode can run once after the user approves it in chat.
Appends a return bound and the posture's soft budget to a subagent brief that states neither.
Pipes verbose test, build and type-check runs through a filter, so only failures, the summary and the tail enter the transcript.
Grades each shell command by reach and asks, or denies, before one the autonomy stance does not cover runs.
With a decision provider configured, also asks before a command its policy level for that repository does not cover, and before any write to a governance policy file.
Reports harness drift, session overrides and the handoff at session start, and records the session's agent registry.
Warns on an edit to a path a live sibling session has claimed, and denies a repeat under the default variant.
Flags instruction-shaped text arriving in tool output, so it is read as data rather than obeyed.
Copies a file SendUserFile names from outside the working directory into it, so a Remote Control client can open it.
Blocks the end of a turn while the repository's gate is red on a changed tree.
Routes each spawn to the model its role or band names; role confinement stays on when this is off.
Feeds measured turn and subagent spend back to the orchestrator on Claude Code.
Records the session's token usage in the local usage ledger at session end.
Checks a written plan file against the Review Card contract and says what it lacks.
Names the other folders of the session's workspace at session start and supplies the instructions the runtime does not load from them.
